#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    long long c[5];
    
    Point(long long a1 = 0, long long a2 = 0, long long a3 = 0, long long a4 = 0, long long a5 = 0) {
        c[0] = a1; c[1] = a2; c[2] = a3; c[3] = a4; c[4] = a5;
    }
    
    static long long sq(long long x) {
        return x * x;
    }
    
    long long lenSq() const {
        return sq(c[0]) + sq(c[1]) + sq(c[2]) + sq(c[3]) + sq(c[4]);
    }
    
    long long dot(const Point& other) const {
        return c[0] * other.c[0] + c[1] * other.c[1] + c[2] * other.c[2] + c[3] * other.c[3] + c[4] * other.c[4];
    }
    
    Point sub(const Point& other) const {
        return Point(c[0] - other.c[0], c[1] - other.c[1], c[2] - other.c[2], c[3] - other.c[3], c[4] - other.c[4]);
    }
};

bool check(Point* points, int n, int i) {
    Point ith = points[i];
    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
        if (j == i) continue;
        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
            if (k == i || k == j) continue;
            Point x = points[j].sub(ith);
            Point y = points[k].sub(ith);
            if (x.dot(y) > 0) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }
    
    Point* points = new Point[n];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        long long a, b, c, d, e;
        cin >> a >> b >> c >> d >> e;
        points[i] = Point(a, b, c, d, e);
    }
    
    vector<int> ret;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (check(points, n, i)) ret.push_back(i + 1);
    }
    
    cout << ret.size() << "\n";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ret.size(); ++i) {
        cout << ret[i] << "\n";
    }
    
    delete[] points;
    return 0;
}
